title: The full adder's truth table
statement: The figure adds three bits $A$, $B$ and $C_{in}$ with two XOR gates, two AND gates and an OR gate. Fill in its truth table net by net, then read off $S$ and $C_{out}$ for $A = 1$, $B = 0$, $C_{in} = 1$.

artefact.caption: Each net in turn, every row of inputs

steps.title: Read the circuit
steps.note: $G_1$ and $G_3$ make the sum, $G_2$ and $G_4$ the two ways a carry starts, and $G_5$ joins them. Work each gate's output net for every row, in the order the signals flow.

steps.title: First XOR
steps.note: $G_1$ gives $A \oplus B$: $1$ when exactly one of $A$ and $B$ is $1$.

steps.title: The sum
steps.note: $G_3$ gives $S = (A \oplus B) \oplus C_{in}$: $1$ when an odd number of the three inputs is $1$.

steps.title: First carry
steps.note: $G_2$ gives $AB$: a carry when $A$ and $B$ are both $1$.

steps.title: Carry through
steps.note: $G_4$ gives $C_{in}(A \oplus B)$: the incoming carry passes when exactly one of $A$ and $B$ is $1$.

steps.title: The carry out
steps.note: $G_5$ gives $C_{out} = AB + C_{in}(A \oplus B)$. On the row $A = 1$, $B = 0$, $C_{in} = 1$: $S = 0$ and $C_{out} = 1$, since $1 + 0 + 1$ is binary $10$.

answer: $S = A \oplus B \oplus C_{in}$ and $C_{out} = AB + C_{in}(A \oplus B)$; for $A = 1$, $B = 0$, $C_{in} = 1$: $S = 0$, $C_{out} = 1$.

stated: the inputs and outputs are bits, $0$ or $1$
